references.text: Stephen refers directly to Moses' birth and describes him as 'beautiful in God's sight' (ἀστεῖος τῷ θεῷ), which corresponds to the Hebrew כִּי־טוֹב הוּא in Exod 2:2.
The Epistle to the Hebrews mentions that Moses' parents hid him for three months because they saw that the child was beautiful (ἀστεῖον τὸ παιδίον), a direct reference to this text.
The expression כִּי־טוֹב ('that it was good') is used here of Moses, just as God saw that His creation was good in Gen 1:31.
This verse gives the genealogical details about Moses' parents, Amram and Jochebed, who gave birth to Moses.
It confirms the lineage and names Jochebed as the mother of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
